static_traits.name: Luo Ting
static_traits.family_status: Has one daughter, who recently Graduated from university and received a Work opportunity
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problems in the past; has not yet received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but willing to express, clear language, self-Reflection ability, fairly cooperative, neutral tone

basic_info.main_problem: Despite active sports participation, running daily and competing in multiple triathlons, I always feel I have 'nothing special', Low sense of self-worth, and frequent Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: The persistent sense of inadequacy significantly affects my self-esteem and overall well-being, prompting me to seek counseling, hoping to ease negative self-perceptions and improve self-esteem.
growth_experiences: After her daughter Graduated from university, Luo Ting's Increased stress began, comparing her own achievements with her daughter's academic and career achievements. Whenever attending her daughter's events, Completing the daily run, or participating in sports events, this comparison triggers strong feelings of inadequacy and Self-doubt. She has not had similar psychological distress in the past, has not yet received psychotherapy, and is in Good physical health.

core_beliefs: I have nothing special about me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my achievements are not more outstanding than others', they do not count as valuable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to prove and stabilize self-worth through sustained engagement in exercise (running daily, multiple triathlons) and rationalization
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am nothing special; what is the point?

special_situations.event: Attending daughter's events or at the milestone of her graduation and Work offer
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my achievements are not as good as my daughter's, it shows I am not as good as her, with lower value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to shift attention to one's own efforts, but still constantly comparing with daughter to evaluate oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as her; nothing I do is worth mentioning

special_situations.event: Seeing the daughter's new project announcement on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' external achievements and recognition are the main standard for measuring self-worth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Browsing information while trying to remind oneself of the value of one's efforts, but finding it hard to maintain positive feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My efforts do not matter; none of this counts

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by achieving more notable, externally recognized results does my worth hold
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Demanding more of oneself with higher standards, hoping to Gain recognition through tougher events

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen, to prove one's own worth and meaning
core_conflict.fear: Fear of seeming inferior in comparison, being ignored or belittled
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of control and lowering the risk of being negated through Intellectualization and self-comparison
Avoiding greater disappointment by starting with self-deprecation

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough, insufficiently valued individual (as a Mother and athlete)
object_relations.object_representation: Idealized successful people (e.g. daughter, others), those who hold the standards of judgment

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or facing the daughter's academic and career achievements, or being invited to evaluate one's own sports achievements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe others (including the counselor) also feel her achievements are not worth recognizing, thereby confirming the 'I am not good enough' belief
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone, Empathetic and non-judgmental; reducing over-Interpretation, inviting her to stay with present experience (e.g. bodily and emotional feelings after completing a run), gently probing her subjective experience of self-worth with open-ended questions.

manifestations: After finishing a run, often thinks 'what is the point of this?'
Believing one's sports achievements do not matter
Feeling diminished life value after comparing with daughter

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently using Self-denial language (e.g. 'I am nothing special')
Overly cautious when sharing achievements and quickly shifts to comparison
Feels nervous about 'opening up' at the start

exception_events.target_problem: After Completing the daily run or sports events, the client typically quickly falls into Self-deprecation and Meaninglessness, leading to Impaired self-esteem and Low mood.
exception_events.unique_outcome: After recently completing a particularly difficult run, the client felt very strong and unstoppable in the moment, briefly feeling proud of herself, without immediately falling into comparison and Self-denial.
exception_events.reason: Different situation: focusing on bodily sensations and the challenge itself in the moment, social media stimuli not yet appearing; different approach: keeping attention on personal effort and experience, thus briefly sustaining the positive experience.

positive_force: Long-term persistence in exercise and self-discipline (daily running, completed multiple triathlons)
Having self-Reflection ability, able to identify and willing to discuss negative thought patterns
Willing to seek help and participate in counseling, relatively stable motivation
Able to experience pride and strength in individual situations (e.g. after a tough run)
Having friends to communicate with in hard times (though not used to talking about vulnerability)
negative_force: Tending to compare and measure self-worth by external standards (especially comparing with daughter's achievements)
Negating the positive and mental filtering, struggling to retain positive experiences
Lacks supporters with whom one can safely talk about vulnerability, limited emotional capacity
Frequent post-exercise Meaninglessness and Self-doubt, forming a negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Post-exercise Self-deprecation and Meaninglessness (with Self-doubt and Decreased self-esteem)
antecedent: Seeing the daughter's social media updates
target_behavior.core_reason: External-validation orientation centered on comparing with daughter and others; negative core beliefs (e.g. 'I am not good enough', 'I have nothing special'); negating the positive and mental filtering quickly erasing positive experiences.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the risk of being negated or disappointed through preemptive Self-deprecation, maintaining a sense of control; reducing emotional investment to ease Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Fun of exercise declining, Daily activities affected, Persistent self-doubt and Low mood.
